_about: The piece resolver's preference among several base records for one mesh (tools/argonia_world/pieces.py; decision 0006 §8, 0012). Tiers win in this order; inside a tier the later plugin in load order, then the placed kind, then the lowest FormID (so vanilla's plain base beats its Snow variant). A plugin takes its tier from the first `plugins` pattern it matches (fnmatch, case-insensitive); an unmatched plugin is `other`. A `kits` row lifts its plugin to the named tier for meshes under its folder, so a kit's own mesh is placed from its own mod. The DLCs and Creation Club rank last: their ash, snow and Solstheim variants never win unless a kit row names the folder (their own dlc01/dlc02 meshes). It lives in data/, not world/db, because it is a build rule over the dependency manifest's plugins, not a world fact.
